name: house-rules
description: Versioned engineering playbook for AI coding agents: checkable rules, skills, and checker CLIs.

plugins.name: house-rules-core
plugins.description: Zero-dependency core tier: graybeard skills, prose-voice, and checker CLIs (bin/defer-lint, bin/banned-token-scan on the Bash PATH; local init also ships scripts/). Always-on contract (explicit downgrade): Claude has no Cursor alwaysApply — core rules ship as discoverable commands/skills, not always-on policy. No task-tracking workflow required.

plugins.name: house-rules-full
plugins.description: The full playbook: beads task workflow, session lifecycle, planning and review skills, and every rule loadable as a command. Pairs with the beads CLI (bd) and the house-rules init installer.
